---
name: Feature Implementation
about: Plan and track a focused feature implementation.
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

> **Status: PLANNED.** Brief statement of current progress
> and next action.

## Motivation

Why is this feature necessary? What problem does it address?
Link relevant issues, findings, or prior results.

## Required behavior

What must the implementation do?

Describe the expected behavior, important invariants,
compatibility requirements, and relevant failure cases.

## Scope and non-goals

Clarify the implementation boundary when necessary.
Avoid unrelated refactoring or additional features.

## Focused implementation

Outline the intended implementation approach and relevant
existing components to reuse.

Prefer the simplest implementation that meets the goal.

## Acceptance tests

- [ ] Required behavior is covered by appropriate tests.
- [ ] Existing behavior is preserved where required.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.

Add feature-specific acceptance criteria as needed.

## Completion and evaluation boundary

What constitutes completion of this implementation?

Distinguish engineering verification from scientific
evaluation. Link a separate evaluation issue when needed.

## Follow-up

Related issues and remaining work, if any.

---

Automatic Codex/Copilot review comments are suggestions,
not requirements. Address real in-scope problems, but do
not unnecessarily broaden or complicate the implementation.
